summary: trading-brain is a prompt-only skill (a single SKILL.md) that loads the operator's personal trading strategy, risk rules and 'next wave' research method into the session for trading crons and buy/sell/hold decisions. It declares no required env vars, yet it expects a Serper news-search helper script, Alpaca brokerage account state, and a local trade-bot config.yaml, none of which ship with the release or appear in metadata. It also reads and writes memory files under ~/clawd. It asks for no wallet, private key or seed, and it contains no download-and-run or encoded payloads.

findings.message: Tells the agent to refresh current positions from Alpaca, which needs brokerage API credentials, but metadata.openclaw.requires.env declares nothing.
Points the agent at ~/Documents/GitHub/trade-bot/config.yaml, a file outside the skill that likely holds broker settings or credentials, so the agent would read undeclared secrets.
Runs the local script ~/clawd/integrations/serper/search.sh, which is not shipped in this release, and sends search queries to the Serper (Google News) API with a key the metadata does not declare.
Directs the agent to scan X/Twitter, Polymarket, Reddit and SCMP/FT as signal sources, which means outbound requests to those hosts, though no endpoints or credentials are specified.
Sets an aggressive $100K-to-$150K mission and drives real-money buy/sell decisions and cron trading, so installing it gives the agent trading influence over live accounts.
Directs $5K-per-trade TQQQ/SQQQ trading on Account 2 and keeps state in ~/clawd/memory/trading/tqqq-sqqq-tracker.json, a local file outside the skill.
Instructs the agent to write every trade's thesis and outcome to ~/clawd/memory/trades.md and to update TRADING-BRAIN.md (line 122), so it persistently modifies files outside the skill directory.
